name: Birds (seabirds and waterfowl)
description: Functional group aggregating the Sound's marine birds - roughly 88% seabirds (alcids such as murres and puffins, black-legged kittiwakes, cormorants, gulls, terns) and 12% overwintering waterfowl (scoters, goldeneyes, harlequin ducks and other ducks) - pooled by the source with a weighted-mean diet. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is in tonnes wet weight per km2, from Table 23 of the source.
